libraries.verified: 2026-11-08 D51: clients inspect CallToolResult.IsError to detect a tool error, and a handler that fails returns a CallToolResult with IsError = true and a readable message; StructuredContent carries the tool's data. So talvora_job_get, talvora_job_stop, talvora_dev_server_get and talvora_dev_server_stop leave IsError unset when the call itself worked, and the job's own exit code stays in StructuredContent. Query: CallToolResult IsError StructuredContent; CallToolResult IsError tool error.
